headline: Kai, the week narrows to a single Wednesday: inflation at 8:30, Nvidia after the bell, and Warsh waiting at Jackson Hole.
subline: Core PCE, durable goods and a GDP revision land this morning; the Street wants $92.2 billion from Nvidia tonight; oil keeps sliding as Iran and Oman talk about reopening Hormuz.
asof: Pre-market · Wednesday ~6:40 AM ET · index rows are futures · every figure links to its source below

items.title: Futures idle into a stacked data morning
items.sentence: S&P 500 futures sit at 7,687 (−0.07%) and Nasdaq 100 futures at 29,215.50 (−0.21%) while Dow futures add 0.10% to 53,701, with gold at $4,682.80, WTI down another 2.68% to $80.15, and bitcoin at $78,998.81, per Yahoo Finance's live blog.

items.title: The 10-year firms to 4.65% before PCE
items.sentence: The benchmark yield edged up 0.02 percentage points to 4.65% early Wednesday, per Trading Economics, leaving little cushion if the 8:30 inflation print runs hot.

items.title: Nvidia tonight: Street wants $92.2 billion, 97% growth
items.sentence: Consensus calls for fiscal Q2 revenue of $92.2 billion, up 97.4%, and EPS of $2.09 when Nvidia reports after the close, per Kiplinger — which notes the stock is roughly flat since October despite three straight beats.

items.title: Core PCE, durables and a GDP revision at 8:30
items.sentence: July core PCE — Barclays looks for +0.2% on the month and 3.2% on the year — arrives alongside durable goods orders and the second read on Q2 GDP, per Kiplinger, ahead of Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote Friday at 10 a.m.

items.title: Bitcoin pauses below $79,000 after the Treasury-fueled sprint
items.sentence: The roughly 18% burst over 48 hours — bitcoin's first time above $70,000 since late May — tracked the Treasury's decision to double long-bond buybacks to $4 billion per session, a liquidity shift Bernstein calls the trigger, per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Canada answers with dollar-for-dollar tariffs on $20 billion
items.sentence: Ottawa set duties of 15% to 50% on nearly $20 billion of US steel, dairy, appliances and electronics effective September 8, after Prime Minister Carney — 'we got attacked' — ended talks over Washington's 50% tariffs, per NPR.

items.title: Oil slides as Iran and Oman talk Hormuz reopening
items.sentence: Brent fell 2.08% overnight to $86.74 as Muscat negotiates a temporary joint shipping route through the strait with Tehran — a precursor, Oman's foreign minister says, to a permanent arrangement — while Washington pivots to economic pressure, per CNBC Africa.

items.title: Meta and 29 states discuss settling the teen-harm trial
items.sentence: Meta and attorneys general from 29 states have held mid-trial settlement talks in the federal case accusing it of deliberately designing Facebook and Instagram to addict young users, Reuters reports via Bloomberg News, with a California jury seated since mid-August.

items.title: Moderna's melanoma vaccine delivers the first mRNA cancer win
items.sentence: Shares rose 14% Tuesday on Phase 3 results for intismeran autogene, the Merck-partnered personalized vaccine, in what the Eastern Herald calls the first late-stage clinical proof of mRNA applied to oncology.

items.title: OpenAI's Jalapeño outruns Blackwell on inference benchmarks
items.sentence: On SemiAnalysis's InferenceX test the Broadcom-co-designed chip served more tokens per user and more throughput per kilowatt than an Nvidia Blackwell system, with volume deployment due in 2027, per TechCrunch.

items.title: Apple's M6 goes 2-nanometer in a new Mac mini
items.sentence: The 12-core M6 — which Apple says has the world's fastest single-threaded performance — arrives in a new Mac mini on September 22, per MacRumors.

items.title: Super Micro rallies on a Cisco AI-infrastructure pact
items.sentence: Shares jumped Tuesday after the company announced a partnership with Cisco to build AI infrastructure, per TheStreet.

items.title: Amazon shuts down Mechanical Turk
items.sentence: Amazon is winding down the crowd-work service Jeff Bezos once called 'artificial artificial intelligence,' per CNBC — the unmodified kind won.
